parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set security zones security-zone trust i.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone trust i.command: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone trust i.explanation: 配置安全区域信任区域的接口允许所有系统服务入站流量。

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: 允许的系统服务类型，例如all。

set security zones security-zone untrust.template: set security zones security-zone [parameter1] interfaces [parameter2] host-inbound-traffic system-services [parameter3]
set security zones security-zone untrust.command: set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: 配置安全区域非信任区域的接口允许所有系统服务入站流量。

parameters.name: system-services
parameters.explanation: 允许的系统服务类型，例如all。

set security nat source pool address-gro.template: set security nat source pool [parameter1] address [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set security nat source pool address-gro.command: set security nat source pool address-group1 address 11.11.11.101 to 11.11.11.105
set security nat source pool address-gro.explanation: 配置源NAT地址池的地址范围。

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] from zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND from zone trust
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集的应用源区域。

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] to zone [parameter2]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND to zone untrust
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: 配置源NAT规则集的应用目标区域。

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] match source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND rule NAT-INSIDE match source-address 192.168.10.0/24
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: 配置源NAT规则匹配的源地址范围。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 源地址范围的子网掩码位数。

set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] then source-nat pool [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.command: set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUND rule NAT-INSIDE then source-nat pool address-group1
set security nat source rule-set OUTBOUN.explanation: 配置源NAT规则的源地址转换行为。

parameters.name: pool
parameters.explanation: 源地址转换使用的地址池名称，例如address-group1。
